description: Known-answer vectors for the parts a cascade or count-only round sends a PSI set (the setup, the request, the response) in. Each part is a 16-byte header -- the part's index and the set's part count as big-endian uint32, then the set's byte length as a big-endian uint64 -- followed by the next slice of the set, at most partPayloadBytes long. The set bytes are synthetic; the engine's serialization is pinned by psi-engine-wire-vectors.json. `refusals` are part sequences a receiver refuses before joining them, with the refusal's fixed tail. Replayed by packages/core/test/psi/psiSetPartVectors.test.ts; regenerate with generate-psi-set-part-vectors.mjs in this directory.

sets.name: an empty set is one part of header alone
a set filling one part exactly
a set one byte over one part
a set of three parts, the last short

refusals.name: a set longer than the receiver's bound
refusals.refusal: declares 21 bytes, over the 20 the agreed record counts admit

refusals.name: a last part short of the declared length
refusals.refusal: ends short of the set's declared length
